name: backrest
title: Backrest
description: Backup orchestrator (restic) with a web UI

defaultEnv.label: Wire the Hola backup hooks automatically
defaultEnv.description: Keep every Backrest repository wired to Hola’s backup-contract hooks, so a snapshot quiesces the apps that need it. Set to false to manage the two Command hooks yourself in the Backrest UI — Hola will then no longer add them back, and an unwired repository captures live database files.
